## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are single-line [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) messages.
- [ ] New or changed behaviour has a focused test with independently derived expected values.
- [ ] Runtime changes have mutants in `tests/mutants.py`, all killed or documented as equivalent.
- [ ] No game files, maps, MPQs, executables, installers, CD keys or recompiled code are included.
- [ ] Documentation is updated where the behaviour changed.
